metadata.captureMethod: Cheerio parse of a server-rendered SPA skeleton captured before hydration; representative of minimal SPA shells with almost no visible text content
metadata.description: Minimal SPA shell: a div#root mount point plus bundled scripts, noscript fallback, and a title. Captured pre-hydration so the visible text content is nearly empty. Exercises the engine's thin-content / main-content-empty cap path on a JS-heavy shell.
